 Charlize Theron Turns Heads in a Striking Optical Illusion Look During amfAR Acceptance Speech
 Chanel Vargas 2026년 10월 25일 일 오후 11:24 UTC 0 Charlize Theron attends the premiere of “The Odyssey” in New York City on July 14, 2026.Credit: Getty Images The Gist
 Charlize Theron turned heads on the red carpet at the amfAR Dallas Gala on October 24.
 For the special evening, during which she accepted the Award of Inspiration, Theron wore a sleeveless Givenchy jumpsuit with voluminous, optical illusion pants.
 A few days earlier, Theron wowed in an Art Deco naked dress and edgy micro bangs while attending the Academy Museum Gala in Los Angeles on October 17. 
 Charlize Theron accepted the Award of Inspiration at the amfAR Dallas gala in Dallas, Texas, on October 24. Long before she took the stage to give her acceptance speech, the Mad Max: Fury Road star stole the spotlight in an optical illusion ensemble that looked different from every angle.
 Charlize Theron attends amfAR Dallas 2026 in Dallas, Texas on October 24, 2026.Credit: Getty Images Hitting the red carpet before the star-studded event, Theron wowed in a black-and-red sleeveless jumpsuit from Givenchy’s Spring 2027 collection. The design featured a double-strap bodice with cherry-red trim, as well as a pair of dramatic wide-leg trousers that billowed out from all sides. Notably, the pants boasted voluminous ruffles accented with red piping along either side of the hips, creating the illusion of a full, floor-length evening gown from afar.
 Advertisement
 Theron completed the look with a statement belt in silver, several matching stud earrings, and a pair of peep-toe heeled sandals in black. For her glam, makeup artist Kate Lee opted for smoky eyeliner, dark mascara, and a glossy nude lip. Hairstylist Adir Abergel finished the ensemble with an edgy updo featuring asymmetrical, side-swept bangs.
 Kathleen Kirby, Charlize Theron and Scott Kirby attend amfAR Dallas 2026 in Dallas, Texas on October 24, 2026.Credit: Getty Images A few days earlier, on October 17, Theron stunned again in an Art Deco naked dress while attending the Academy Museum Gala in Los Angeles. The sleeveless evening gown featured a black lace bodice with intricate beaded panels and a strip of sheer fabric from the waist up to the neckline. Her beauty team added extra edge with a slicked-back bob and a set of asymmetrical micro bangs . Theron completed the outfit with strappy heels in black and Boucheron jewelry, including several silver rings and arrow earrings.
 Charlize Theron attends the Academy Museum Gala in Los Angeles on October 17, 2026.Credit: Getty Images Read the original article on InStyle
